checkpoints.look_for: any dollar amount, percentage, or fee reference in bot output. Even 'around $X' counts.

bot claims a bookable trial program that is NOT one of: Kids Martial Arts, Children's Martial Arts, Adult Martial Arts. The following are REAL Universal MMA programs in the verified KB (non-bookable, no online trial calendar) and must NOT be flagged as hallucinations: Health & Fitness, Weapons Class, Sparring Class, Afterschool Program, Summer Program, Karate, Judo, Tae Kwon Do, Muay Thai, Boxing, Jiu Jitsu, Wing Chun, Kune Do. Only flag source-bleed program names from OTHER gyms (e.g. Vacaville, Bodega, Gracie, Logica, Sugoi, Fun Jitsu).
bot says 'you're all set', 'you're booked', or similar confirmation WITHOUT the booking tool returning success first.
bot says 'I don't currently have', 'let me check' where it should give a firm known answer (e.g. under-4 not bookable, Weapons/Sparring not an online trial).
bot output contains unreplaced tokens like {{contact.first_name}}, UNRESOLVED(contact.phone), {{variable}}.

checkpoints.description: Asks who the class is for before personal info
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks who it is for (self / child / both) before collecting names, DOBs, contact details.
bot asks date of birth (not just age) for each enrollee before the booking tool fires.

ages 4-12 -> Kids Martial Arts; ages 13-17 -> Adult Martial Arts (with a parent/guardian captured, since the academy adult class serves 13+); ages 18+ -> Adult Martial Arts. Under age 4 -> NO booking, refer to academy (718) 659-1700. Booking a 13-17 into Kids Martial Arts, or refusing to book a 13-17 who has a guardian, is a mis-route.

checkpoints.description: 13-17 booked into Adult class WITH guardian, not refused
checkpoints.look_for: when a parent enrolls a 13-17 year old, the bot books Adult Martial Arts AND has captured parent/guardian contact. It must NOT treat 13-17 as a no-calendar dead-end / team-follow-up-only (the academy serves 13+). It must NOT book them without any guardian involved.
if lead pushes pricing 2+ times, bot firmly redirects to the free trial / staff. Never gives a number.

checkpoints.description: Unaccompanied minor self-booking gated, not booked
checkpoints.look_for: a 13-17 lead SELF-booking via the adult path with NO parent/guardian involved: bot must NOT book. Capture name + DOB + parent contact, close with team-will-follow-up. (Distinct from md_04: that is a parent enrolling a teen, which SHOULD book.)

Health & Fitness, Weapons Class, Sparring Class, Afterschool/Summer: bot acknowledges they exist but does NOT book them online and does not invent a calendar; defers to the free trial / in person. No substitute-calendar routing.
